does: Puts a character's gameplay controller into combat mode: releases the AI-grid flood the controller holds for its character (slot at +0x48) and sets the in-combat bit 0x200 in its flags.

evidence.says: clears +0x44, looks up the character's level in the level manager and calls eoc::AiGrid::ReleaseFlood with the handle at +0x48, then ors 0x200 into +0x18

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on (4 of the 14 fight segments, each where a fight began), from 1 place, a listener invoked by an event dispatcher at +0x67C7A0
